decision: Validate that TensorLBM's force-corrected NEBB + body-force driver reproduces the closed-form Poiseuille solution within <15% (owner standard) and <3% (ecosystem stretch).
alternatives: A: D2Q9 NEBB module (tensorlbm.nebb_bodyforce.BodyForceChannel) with force-corrected wall velocity and shear-reconstruction NEBB
B: D3Q19 main solver (GPUCorePathSolver) with Guo forcing + half-way bounce-back
C: OSS vivsim D2Q9 reference (NOT_RUN, jax absent)
hypothesis: H1: Force-corrected NEBB (arm A) reproduces analytic Poiseuille to machine precision (<1e-12). H2: D3Q19 main solver (arm B) reproduces analytic Poiseuille within <3%. H3: No-slip is enforced (first fluid row matches analytic value at that row within 1% of u_max). H4: Grid refinement shows monotonic convergence.

metrics.primary: max pointwise relative error of steady ux(y) profile vs closed-form Poiseuille (interior fluid rows)
metrics.secondary: u_max relative error, no-slip check (first fluid row vs analytic at that row)

baseline_control: Closed-form Poiseuille solution u_x(y) = G_x/(2ν) · (y-y₀) · (H-(y-y₀)) with y₀=0 for NEBB (wall at node plane) and y₀=0.5 for half-way BB.
stopping_rule: Fixed work: run both arms at ny=10 and ny=20, with ν=0.2, u_max=0.05, gx=1e-3. Steps capped at 200,000 (A) and 8,000 (B) with steady-state check (residual <1e-13). No result-dependent extension.

controlled: D2Q9 lattice (arm A) / D3Q19 lattice (arm B), c_s² = 1/3
float64 CPU, periodic x (and z for D3Q19), no-slip top/bottom walls
initial condition: f = feq(ρ=1, u = -g/2) for arm A; rest for arm B
changed: forcing scheme (EDM, Guo-BGK) for arm A
confounders: wall position convention: NEBB has wall at node plane (y₀=0), half-way BB has wall at y₀=0.5
D2Q9 vs D3Q19 lattice differences (isotropy, discrete velocity set)
EDM vs Guo-BGK forcing schemes (different force term formulations)

repetition_rationale: Deterministic simulation: repeat runs reproduce bit-for-bit. Verified by running the driver twice and diffing output JSON.
analysis: Primary metric = max pointwise relative error (interior rows); pass iff <= 15%. Ecosystem stretch = pass iff <= 3%. No-slip check: first fluid row matches analytic value at that row within 1% of u_max. Convergence: monotonic error reduction with grid refinement.
safety_resource_limits: Whole driver < 2 min on one CPU core; no cluster submission needed; no file outside the worktree is touched.
interpretation_limits: Single-phase, static geometry, CPU float64, BGK only
D2Q9 (2D) and D3Q19 (3D with 1×ny×1 effective 2D) only
Wall models: force-corrected NEBB and half-way bounce-back only
Not tested: moving walls, curved boundaries, multiphase, turbulence
